steps.say: The commonest childhood kidney cancer grows from leftover kidney seeds, striking mostly before school age. A parent feeling a belly lump starts most cases.
steps.tx: The commonest childhood kidney cancer grows from leftover seeds. **Wilms tumour** (**nephroblastoma**) is an embryonal metanephric blastema renal neoplasm causing **5.9 percent** (five point nine percent) of paediatric malignancies, **75 percent** (seventy five percent) under **5 years** (five years), and **bilateral disease** (both kidneys) in **13 percent** (thirteen percent) at diagnosis. A parent feeling a belly lump starts most cases.

steps.say: Genes and syndromes flag the at-risk child, linking kidney tumours with eye, genital and overgrowth clues. Screen these children with regular scans.
steps.tx: Genes and syndromes flag the at-risk child. **WT1** (kidney gene) at **11p13** (eleven p thirteen) governs kidney, gonad and eye development so mutation brings cryptorchidism, hypospadias and aniridia, WT2 at **11p15** (eleven p fifteen) links **Beckwith Wiedemann** (overgrowth syndrome) with hemihypertrophy, and **WAGR syndrome** (deletion syndrome), Denys Drash, Li Fraumeni and neurofibromatosis predispose. Screen these children with regular scans.

vis.alt: Diagram of WAGR syndrome showing Wilms tumour, congenital aniridia and cryptorchidism.
vis.caption: WAGR deletion links Wilms tumour with aniridia and genital anomalies. WT1 governs kidney, gonad and eye development. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: A felt lump leads while the rest whisper: vague ache, bloody urine, high pressure and lung spots. Never squeeze the lump hard, because rupture upstages.
steps.tx: A felt lump leads; the rest whisper. An **abdominal mass** (belly lump) found by parent or examination leads, with vague pain, **hematuria** (blood in urine) from collecting system invasion, **hypertension** (high blood pressure) in **25 percent** (twenty five percent) via renin angiotensin disturbance, and lung metastases in **8 percent** (eight percent). Never squeeze the lump hard; rupture upstages.

steps.say: Images separate Wilms from its great mimic, which crosses the midline and calcifies. Look for the kidney clasping the tumour and a cancer clot running up the great vein.
steps.tx: Images separate Wilms from its great mimic. Ultrasound finds renal vein or caval **tumour thrombus** (cancer clot), computed tomography separates Wilms from mimics and maps nodes, contralateral kidney and distant spread, and the **claw sign** (kidney clasping tumour) with caval thrombus up the **inferior vena cava** (great vein) to the atrium is classic. Neuroblastoma instead crosses the midline and calcifies.

vis.alt: Diagram comparing intrarenal Wilms tumour with midline crossing neuroblastoma and a Homer Wright rosette inset.
vis.caption: Wilms grows inside the kidney with a claw of normal tissue while neuroblastoma crosses the midline. Rosettes mark the mimic. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: The microscope decides the danger, splitting gentle three part tumours from hostile ones. Any ugly scattered cells anywhere escalate the whole treatment.
steps.tx: The microscope decides the danger. **Favourable histology** (friendly pattern) means blastemal, stromal and epithelial elements from persistent **nephrogenic rests** (leftover kidney seeds), with epithelial predominant behaving gently, while unfavourable means focal or diffuse **anaplasia** (ugly cells), clear cell sarcoma or rhabdoid tumour with chemoresistance and recurrence. Anaplasia anywhere escalates therapy.

steps.say: Stages run one to five with no skipping, and any spill or needle track climbs the ladder. Harvest nodes at surgery, and never rupture the capsule.
steps.tx: Stages run one to five with no skipping. **NWTS staging** (Wilms stages) runs I confined and intact, II through capsule or spilled locally, III abdominal residual or nodes, IV hematogenous spread, V bilateral, with caval thrombus upstaging management and any biopsy or **tumour spillage** (operative spill) upstaging the child. Staging needs hilar and paraaortic **lymph node sampling** (node harvest); never rupture the capsule.

steps.say: Remove wide without touching the tumour, sampling nodes along the great vessels. Save part of the kidney only for single kidneys or both sides after shrinking drugs.
steps.tx: Remove wide without touching the tumour. Standard surgery is **radical nephrectomy** (whole kidney removal) with hilar, paraaortic and paracaval **lymph node sampling** (node harvest) in en bloc no touch technique, **nephron sparing surgery** (partial kidney saving) reserved for solitary kidney or bilateral disease after shrinking chemotherapy. Touch the tumour and the stage climbs.

steps.say: Drugs cure most, with the recipe set by stage and microscope. Friendly early disease nears total cure while hostile advanced disease falls hard.
steps.tx: Drugs cure most; stages set the recipe. Chemotherapy is **vincristine** (weekly jab) with **dactinomycin** (antibiotic chemo) adding doxorubicin and radiation by stage, favourable stage I reaches near **95 percent** (ninety five percent) **survival rate** (cure chances) while unfavourable stages II, III and IV fall to **70, 56 and 17 percent** (seventy, fifty six and seventeen percent) at **4 years** (four years). Histology plus stage writes the protocol.
